# nfldoinkeR

nfldoinkeR loads Off the Upright's NFL doink data (kicks that hit a goalpost or crossbar) into R: doinks, kickers and teams through load_doinks(), load_doink_kickers() and load_doink_teams(), with doink_release_info() for release details. It pairs with nflreadr through nflverse game ids (1999 onward) and gsis_id. The data comes from Off the Upright (offtheupright.com), and the package is available from GitHub.

The package contains no data and never contacts offtheupright.com; it reads the releases of [nfldoinkeR-data](https://github.com/ke1v3y/nfldoinkeR-data).

## Installation

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("ke1v3y/nfldoinkeR")
```

## Example

```r
library(nfldoinkeR)
doinks <- load_doinks(2024)
doinks
```

```r
doink_release_info()$built_at
```

Kicker and team profiles are `load_doink_kickers()` and `load_doink_teams()`.
The `doink` in those names avoids masking `nflreadr::load_teams()`.

## Coverage

Doinks from 1974; joinable to nflverse from 1999. Games before the 1999 season
have no `nflverse_game_id`, because nflverse's schedule data has no rows there.

The current release is data version `r info$data_version`, built
`r info$built_at`. It holds `r info$rows$doinks` doinks from seasons
`r info$seasons$min` to `r info$seasons$max`, of which
`r info$nflverse_join$doinks_keyed` carry an `nflverse_game_id`.
`r info$nflverse_join$doinks_unkeyed_1999_on` doinks from 1999 on do not yet
have one. These counts are read from the release manifest each time this file
is knitted.

The data are released under CC-BY-4.0. Please credit them as:

> Data from Off the Upright, offtheupright.com

To cite a specific cut of the data, cite the dated release tag
(`vYYYY.MM.DD`) of the release you used, for example
`v2026.10.27` of
[nfldoinkeR-data](https://github.com/ke1v3y/nfldoinkeR-data/releases), not
`latest`, which moves. Run `citation("nfldoinkeR")` for the package citation.
